title: AI Emoji Kitchen Lab
description: 这是一个基于深度学习的表情符号（Emoji）融合项目，旨在于通过大模型实现Google Emoji Kitchen风格的表情符号融合，能够将两个不同的emoji融合成一个全新的、富有创意的emoji图像。

title: PDF Summary Tool
description: 一个强大的Python工具，用于将PDF文档转换为结构化文本，并利用先进的AI模型生成高质量的内容总结和关键词提炼。

title: TeX-QB-Gen
description: Generate question banks directly from textbooks.  Leverage OpenRouter's multimodal/text models and local OCR capabilities to extract math problems and solutions from images, web pages, or PDFs, and generate uniformly formatted TeX question banks.

title: bibliotheca-runnel
description: This is the personal academic portal and digital archive of myself. It serves as a curated collection of knowledge, spanning from informal mathematical notes to classical literary works and linguistic research.

title: CER System
description: 基于 Qwen2-Audio 7B 多模态大模型的银行客户服务情绪实时分析系统。该系统采用双路径架构（Dual-Path Architecture），结合 Plan A（高灵敏 VAD）与 Plan B（高精度说话人分离），灵活适配不同质量与场景的通话录音。
